note: 1600 -> 1390 (-210), all declaration gaps rather than type errors, in two places. (1) -197 from odoo/libs/_field_access/tests/test_field_access.py, which alone was 12% of the floor. It is the fallback-vs-Rust differential suite: one _FieldAccessTestMixin holding ~100 tests, subclassed twice as (mixin, unittest.TestCase). The mixin declared no TestCase base, so every self.assertEqual in it was [attr-defined] (116), and its nine hook attributes defaulted to 'Callable | None' though both subclasses bind all nine in setUpClass, so every call site was 'None not callable' [misc] (79), plus 2 [var-annotated] on empty dict literals. Fixed by declaring the base under TYPE_CHECKING only -- at runtime the mixin stays a plain object, so neither unittest discovery nor pytest collects it and runs its tests unbound -- and by annotating the nine hooks without assigning, which is the real contract and turns a forgotten binding into an AttributeError naming it. 162 tests still pass. (2) -13 from completing libs/worker_thread.WorkerThread, the Protocol over the per-thread state Odoo hangs off threading.Thread. It was missing 'type', 'start_time' and 'exec_context' though service/_threaded, service/wsgi, service/model and tools/profiler all set them, and it was bypassed at the sites that bind state onto a thread that is not the caller -- so a new as_worker_thread(thread) covers those, current_worker_thread() is now defined in terms of it, and the setter sites use one or the other. The Protocol also now records that every member is optional in practice and dbname visibly so, since ir_cron/ir_job del it around a job: it describes the vocabulary, not a guarantee. The 2 remaining Thread [attr-defined] are a test's own _probe_attr, correctly not in the Protocol.
